{"draft": "American International Group (AIG) — Q2 2026
Results:
- Net income attributable to common shareholders: $948 million, or $1.78 per diluted share
- Adjusted after-tax income: $1.1 billion, or $2.00 per diluted share, up 10% year-over-year
- ROE: 9.4%; Core Operating ROE: 11.1%

- Net investment income on an APTI basis: $908 million, compared with $955 million a year earlier

- Catastrophe-related charges: $210 million, representing 3.4 loss ratio points
- Favorable prior year development: $145 million
Cash and capital:
- Capital returned to shareholders: $904 million, including $641 million of share repurchases and $263 million of dividends
